title: Concept: renv lockfile entry without a hash
description: renv.lock declares a locked R package that records no `Hash`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: `renv::restore()` cannot verify the installed package against the lockfile, so a repository substitution is invisible.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through renv.lock (cran).
risk: `renv::restore()` cannot verify the installed package against the lockfile, so a repository substitution is invisible.
